subject: Renewal QBR — regional demo windows and overnight fallback
messages:
From: Lina Ortiz <lina.ortiz@clearlinehealth.com>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Diego Ramos <diego.r@clearlinehealth.com>
Date: Fri, 20 Nov 2026 23:10:00 -0500
Subject: Renewal QBR — need to revisit demo window for regional execs

Hi Grace / Marissa —

Thanks again for the roadmap preview last month. We're finalizing the QBR cadence for our renewal week (week of Dec 13) and want to make sure the roadmap demo includes stakeholders in APAC and LATAM leadership. Right now the demo is on our calendar at 17:00 ET which excludes most APAC execs.

Two asks from our side:
- Can Redwood propose an alternate window that captures APAC leadership (ideally a single live demo rather than two region-specific runs)?
- We'd like a 30-minute technical dry-run with your engineering lead one week prior that includes our Product Ops (cc'd).

Attaching our participant list so you can see overlap constraints. Also flagging that our CIO may want to join the first 15 minutes — if we shift times we'll need a short contingency plan in case their availability changes last minute.

Attachments: Clearline-participant-list.csv (csv)

Appreciate a few options and a fallback plan.

—Lina Ortiz
Head of Product, Clearline Health
Lina Ortiz | clearlinehealth.com

From: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwoodinference.com>
To: Lina Ortiz <lina.ortiz@clearlinehealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sat, 21 Nov 2026 09:30:00 -0500
Subject: Re: Renewal QBR — need to revisit demo window for regional execs

Lina —

Thanks for the participant list — helpful. We can accommodate a single live demo and have two approaches depending on how early you want it:

Option A (preferred, minimal fragmentation): 00:00–02:00 UTC (evening LATAM / early morning EMEA / workable for APAC execs joining late local time).
Option B (if CIO needs daylight): 22:00–23:30 UTC + recorded follow-up highlights for APAC (we can do a trimmed replay segment at 08:00 SGT for APAC stakeholders).

For the 30-minute dry-run, we can schedule: 1) a technical dry-run with Karthik + our infra engineer, 2) a run-through with your Product Ops and the demo hosts. Proposed dry-run slot: Dec 6 at 01:00–01:30 UTC (this lines up with Option A). If that doesn't work we'll propose a second dry-run that overlaps with your EMEA ops.

Contingency plan (high level):
- Primary live: Option A (00:00–02:00 UTC)
- Fallback: If CIO unavailable 15m before the demo, we run full demo as planned and trigger executive join-in via recorded 5m briefing + live Q&A (we'll keep 20 minutes reserved for exec Q&A).
- If infra signals high load, automatic fallback to a smaller model variant with identical prompt/flow (we'll test this in dry-run).

I've attached our draft runbook and a compact deck for the roadmap/demo flow. Karthik, can you confirm the dry-run attendees from infra and whether you need anything from Clearline to validate the network/latency path?

Attachments: redwood-qbr-runbook-v1.pdf (application/pdf), redwood-qbr-demo-deck.pptx (application/vnd.ms-powerpoint)

Thanks — looking forward to locking this in.

Best,
Grace O'Connor
Customer Success Manager | Redwood Inference
grace.oconnor@redwoodinference.com
+1 (415) 555-0136

From: Lina Ortiz <lina.ortiz@clearlinehealth.com>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Clearline Product Ops <ops@clearlinehealth.com>, Diego Ramos <diego.r@clearlinehealth.com>
Date: Sun, 21 Nov 2026 16:47:00 -0500
Subject: Re: Renewal QBR — need to revisit demo window for regional execs

Grace —

Option A looks good to us. Our execs in APAC have confirmed they'd join the late local slot for 00:00–02:00 UTC, and Product Ops can attend the dry-run on Dec 6 01:00 UTC.

A couple of asks from ops:
- Can Redwood share a short runbook checklist we can surface to our IT team for the network check (ideally a single page).
- Please include a recording permission notice at the top of the live calendar invite; some of our execs require permission before recording.

Diego (cc) will coordinate attendee names for the dry-run and send a final headcount tomorrow.

Appreciate the fallback descriptions. Let's lock on Option A and dry-run slot.

—Lina

Lina — locking this in from our side.

Actions completed:
- Calendar: created calendar invite for Dec 14, 00:00–02:00 UTC (shared with Clearline execs). Invite includes recording permission checkbox and a one-line recording consent reminder in the description.
- Dry-run: scheduled Dec 6, 01:00–01:30 UTC and invited Karthik, Grace, Diego and Clearline Product Ops.
- Ops checklist: extracted a single-page network checklist from the runbook and linked it in the invite. 
- Recording/permissions: added note and an agenda to the invite; recording will be toggled on but explicit permission requested at the start.

Drive links / resources: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1aBcD_qbr-clearline
HubSpot: https://app.hubspot.com/deal/CL-2026-0917
Attachments posted to invite: redwood-qbr-runbook-v1.pdf, redwood-qbr-demo-deck.pptx

Karthik — can you confirm infra will run the quick latency check 24 hours before the demo and post results to the Drive folder? If there's a failure we'll switch to the fallback smaller-variant flow and notify Diego 30 minutes before start.

Thanks — Marissa
